decision.observation: The farmer is stopped at a fence east of the river; there is a narrow opening in the vertical fence just below, beside a flowering plant.
decision.hypothesis: Moving south to the fence opening will allow passage east and then south toward the beach.
decision.memory: One parsnip is planted and watered; 14 seeds remain. Willy has a gift at the beach. Cross the town river bridge, take the southbound path, then turn east at the cliff; a fence gap lies just south of the current position.
